recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a bounded source correction in the active CapabilityStatement definition and completes the accepted clarification without duplicating narrative guidance or changing REST-specific server/client rules.
issue_request: FHIR-26431 was Published/Persuasive for R5 after FHIR-I accepted that CapabilityStatement introductory text must not describe only FHIR servers because clients can publish CapabilityStatements and CapabilityStatement.rest.mode includes client.
initial_application: Commit 93cf3cf32e applied FHIR-26431 by changing the root CapabilityStatement description and definition from "FHIR Server" to "FHIR Server or Client", but left adjacent phrases saying "actual server functionality", "required or desired server implementation", and "the server will have multiple statements".
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini and is assigned to the conformance chapter. The current narrative introduction already describes actual software, applications, and desired systems, and the StructureDefinition already exposes rest.mode as "client | server". FHIR-I Confluence minutes corroborate the 2020-07-13 persuasive vote, and targeted Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting rationale.
reconciliation: Updated source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml so the root description and definition say "actual system functionality" and "required or desired system implementation", and changed the root multiple-version comment from "the server" to "the system". TerminologyCapabilities was intentionally left unchanged because it is specifically terminology-server scoped.
source_changes: source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml: generalized the root description and definition from server-only functionality/implementation wording to system wording, and changed the multiple-version root comment from server to system.
